I was certain that someone was trolling me. But then I did a bit of research, and learned that MCC 5967 was indeed the standard-issue code for smut.

It also levies a higher penalty on MCC 5967 merchants for exceeding chargeback thresholds than for similarly non-compliant merchants processing under a different MCC.
